name: February 17, 2021
agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  Parks, Recreation and Community Services

  ARTS COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
  February 17, 2021 6:30 p.m.
  Via Zoom

  COVID-19 PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS

Due to the existing COVID-19 health emergency and the social distancing
measures currently in effect, and pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-
29-20 ((https://www.gov.ca.gov/wp- content/uploads/2020/03/3.17.20-N-29-20-
EO.pdf)), please note that members of the public will only be allowed to observe
and address the Arts Commission Meeting of February 17, 2021 at 6:30 P.M. by
telephone or video as follows:

Members of the public who wish to listen, view and or orally address the Arts
Commission must use the public access options noted below:

Listening to the Meeting and Making Oral Public Comments:
   Members of the public may view, listen and make oral public comments
  telephonically by:

  View, Listen and Comments

  Visit zoom.us/join. Meeting ID: 862 6110 8990 Passcode: 620145
  One tap mobile - +16699006833,,86261108990#,,,,*620145#

  Listen only and Comments

  Dial +1 669 900 6833 Meeting ID: 86261108990 Passcode: 620145

Please observe the following tips when phoning in:

    When you log-in/call-in, except for meeting presenters and speakers, all
  microphones and video cameras will be muted/off.
    When you are making public comments, you line will be unmuted.

  Written Public Comments: Members of the public can submit comments for
  consideration by the Arts Commission by sending them to Stephanie Maldondado,
  Senior Management Assistant, at smaldonado@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure
  distribution to the members of the Arts Commission prior to consideration of the
  agenda, comments must be received prior to 12:00 P.M. on February 17, 2021, the
  day of the meeting. Correspondence should indicate the meeting date and agenda
  item. Comments received after 12:00 P.M. will be made part of the official public
  record of the meeting.

[Agenda Items and Additional Public Access Options Listed on Following
Pages]
   CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  Parks, Recreation and Community Services

  ARTS COMMISSION
  MEETING AGENDA
  February 17, 2021 6:30 p.m.
  Via Zoom

  I.  Opening
   Call to order
   Salute to the flag
   Roll Call

  II.  Public Comments – Agenda Items Only

 III.  Approval of Minutes
   Meeting held December 9, 2020

 IV.  Special Presentation - Christopher L. Mercier: f.e.r. residential architecture in
  Inglewood

  V.  Staff Reports
  N/A

 VI.  Verbal Reports Regarding the following Public Art Related Projects
  a. Rogers Park Artist in Residence Update – off site until March 5
  b. Love, Inglewood collection enhancement and installation

VII.  Public Comments – Regarding Items Not On the Agenda

VIII.  Commissioners’ Comments/ Initiatives / Art Calendar
  a. March 17, 2021 6:30 p.m.: Next Arts Commission Meeting

 IX.  Adjournment

In the event that the Arts Commission meeting of February 17, 2021 is not held, agenda
items will automatically be continued to the next regular Arts Commission meeting.
(Note: The above procedures are subject to change for future Commission meetings.
Please refer to future Arts Commission agendas for public participation option
procedures at that time.)
